title: FastDyn accepted to IEEE S&P 2025 with Distinguished Paper Award!
description: Our paper 'FastDyn: High-Throughput Dynamic Binary Analysis via Adaptive QEMU Execution Slicing' has been accepted to IEEE S&P 2025 and awarded a Distinguished Paper Award. Congratulations to Alex Chen and the team!

title: New NSF SaTC Grant Awarded for Confidential Computing
description: PSecLab has received a new NSF SaTC award to advance hardware-enforced micro-compartmentalization in confidential virtual machines.

title: ddsfuzz presented at USENIX Security '24 (Best Artifact Award)
description: Sarah Miller presented ddsfuzz in Philadelphia, uncovering 19 CVEs in robot middleware and winning the USENIX Security Artifact Award.

title: Welcome new Ph.D. students & Summer Research Fellows!
description: We are excited to welcome new graduate and undergraduate researchers joining PSecLab for systems security and cyber-physical resilience research.

title: xbin released as open source on GitHub
description: We open-sourced xbin, our multi-backend binary orchestration pipeline supporting Ghidra, angr, and Binary Ninja.
